IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on State Government & Tribal Affairs.

Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the great blue heron as the official bird of the state of Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to naming the state bird; and amending RCW1.20.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 1.20.040 and 1951 c 249 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The ((willow goldfinch)) great blue heron is hereby designated asthe official bird of the state of Washington.
